title: Per-model kernel selection matrix and pin/publish workflow for MHA/GQA/MoE onboarding
creator: Ayesha Khan
description: Create a reproducible workflow and data model for publishing a per-model kernel selection matrix and pinned compilation profile for multi-headed attention (MHA), grouped-query attention (GQA) and mixture-of-experts (MoE) variants. This ticket covers: defining the matrix schema, integrating the kernel autotuner outputs, adding metadata to the model catalog, specifying pin semantics for model+kernel bundles, CI gating for deterministic builds, and publishing a performance profile page used by Console and Optimize to drive routing and rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Matrix schema defined and documented in Confluence with field-level semantics (model_family, model_version, kernel_bundle_id, compile_flags, hardware_tags, expected_latency_p50/p95, cost_per_token_estimate)

Autotuner output is consumed and mapped into the matrix for existing MHA/GQA/MoE onboarding runs (at least 6 models: bert-large-MHA, llama-2-gqa, llama-2-moe-experimental, redwood-mix-1, gpt-neox-gqa, custom-cust-moex)
Published kernel bundles are pinned in the model catalog and referenced by model_version metadata via stable kernel_bundle_id strings
CI job runtime/benchmarks verify deterministic kernel builds and fail on ABI drift for pinned bundles
Console shows per-model recommended kernel bundle and a link to the performance profile with test vectors and measurement context
Rollout config supports gradual switch from unpinned heuristic selection to pinned production bundles with automatic fallback to compatible variants
technical_notes: Kernel bundle identity will use semantic tag: <kernel_major>.<kernel_minor>+hash (e.g., 3.2+9f7c) to allow minor fixes without breaking declared major behavior
Tune compile_flags for each architecture family: fused_mha=true for standard MHA; fused_gqa=true + split_k=auto for GQA; moe_routing_opt=balanced with expert-fusion for MoE layers
Include hardware_tags: [a100, h100, l4] to indicate validated hardware; runtime will refuse to pin a bundle without matching hardware validation
Autotuner outputs (tile_size, thread_block_config, use_tensor_cores, fp8_profile) get normalized to a stable profile file that is checked into the kernel registry
Add a backward-compatible compatibility_map for kernel ABI changes; runtime uses the compatibility map to find allowed fallbacks when pinned kernel is unavailable
KV cache layout and alignment must be explicitly tested per bundle; note MoE impacts on memory accounting due to expert activations
Bench harness will measure sequence lengths [32, 128, 512, 2048], batch sizes [1, 8, 64], and dynamic prompt prefix reuse scenarios to estimate cost/latency curves
benchmarks: Initial autotune runs show fused_mha bundle (3.2+9f7c) reduces p50 token latency by ~18% at seq=512 vs baseline generic kernels on H100
GQA-specific bundle reduces memory bandwidth by 12% and increases throughput 1.3x at batch=8 for llama-2-gqa on A100
MoE-specific bundle shows expected reduction in token-cost when sparsity > 0.6, but increases cold-start latency due to expert weight swaps; add warmup policy in runtime
All published profiles include p50/p95/p99, cost_per_1000_tokens (USD estimate for hosted), and test vector hash used for regression checks
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Schema and registry - add kernel matrix schema in Confluence and implement kernel_registry service (read-only) behind feature flag
Phase 2: Autotuner integration - map autotuner outputs to kernel bundles and generate initial bundles for 6 model families
Phase 3: CI & gating - add deterministic build check, diff against baseline bundles, and create PR enforcement for kernel bundle publishing
Phase 4: Console/Optimize integration - surface recommended bundle and expose 'pin model to bundle' button in Console behind controlled rollout
Phase 5: Gradual rollouts - enable model-level pinning for non-critical customers, monitor SLO/regressions, then expand to high-traffic tenants
Rollback: runtime falls back to nearest-compatible kernel bundle as defined in compatibility_map and records an incident event for postmortem

status_history: 2026-03-12: Planned - CI prototype completed, awaiting integration
risks: Pinning semantics can block emergency fixes: need patch-level override policy and emergency-unpin workflow
ABI drift across GPUs may cause a pinned bundle to be invalid on some hardware; mitigation = hardware_tags and compatibility_map
MoE memory/regrowth can cause unanticipated OOMs during rollout; conservative default rollout percentages and warmup are required
Performance regressions may be subtle; invest in deterministic bench harness and test-vector based regression alerts
